Name: Emily portrait more like sprite
Author: vigo1308
Description:
Whenever I talk to Emily, it bothers me that her sprite and portrait aren't really the same (sprite has hair parted the other way and hair tucked behind ear, dress has sleeves and collar in portrait while sprite has lower cut and sleeveless dress) so I decided to change it to be more like her sprite. This is the first mod I ever make so I'm not sure if it's any good but I gave it a shot.

Once 1.1 comes out and she can be married, I plan to edit any new portraits that she'll have too.

If anyone would like for me to edit her sprite to be more like her portrait instead, let me know and I can do that.

Put the file in \Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits (back up the original first just in case)

Edit about 1.1: I probably won't be updating this mod for 1.1, so if you'd like to edit the mod yourself and share it somewhere I am a-okay with it :) however please do give me credit for the original mod if you share it
